WITH user_scores AS (
    SELECT 
        u.userkey,
        u.substatus,
        u.seglabel,
        u.gendlbl,
        u.occulbl,
        u.subdays,
        u.ageval,
        u.user_preferences->>'interests' as interests,
        -- USV = subdays * statusWeight
        u.subdays * CASE u.substatus 
            WHEN 'Premium' THEN 2.0 
            WHEN 'Enterprise' THEN 3.0 
            WHEN 'Basic' THEN 1.0 
            ELSE 0.5 
        END AS usv,
        -- UDS = ageval * genderFactor * occupationFactor
        u.ageval * CASE u.gendlbl 
            WHEN 'M' THEN 1.0 
            WHEN 'F' THEN 1.0 
            WHEN 'Other' THEN 0.8 
            ELSE 0.8 
        END * CASE u.occulbl 
            WHEN 'Professional' THEN 1.5 
            WHEN 'Retired' THEN 1.2 
            WHEN 'Student' THEN 0.7 
            WHEN 'Other' THEN 1.0 
            ELSE 1.0 
        END AS uds
    FROM users u
)
SELECT 
    substatus,
    seglabel,
    gendlbl,
    occulbl,
    ROUND(CAST(AVG(usv) AS numeric), 2) AS avg_usv,
    ROUND(CAST(AVG(uds) AS numeric), 2) AS avg_uds,
    COUNT(*) AS user_count,
    STRING_AGG(interests, ',' ORDER BY interests) AS shared_interests
FROM user_scores
GROUP BY substatus, seglabel, gendlbl, occulbl
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 10
ORDER BY avg_usv DESC, avg_uds DESC
LIMIT 15;
